body:
Benzodiazepine experience: lormetazepam, temazepam, etizolam, lorazepam, diazepam, alprazolam, oxazepam, clonzepam (zolpidem and zoplicon.
Other GABAeric experience: GHB, phenibut, alcohol
I like to do benzo's sometimes to just chill and relax a bit. You could say I have a mild tolerance (4-5 times a moth use). I have used around 10 different benzos, but clonazepam was always my favorite.
Flunitrazepam was the benzo that I needed the right moment for, because this one was praised as the king of benzos that erased all your memory. So finally I had a friday after work and a day after free and wanted to try this one.
Disclaimer: I drink one or two beers sometimes with benzos. It is strongly advised to stay away from alcohol while taking them. Not only because drinking increases the memory erasing significantly, but also because you can die.
T + 0:00 I took 1.5mg flunitrazepam halfway of my 6% beer. I notice that I am a bit nervous for this benzo, but in a healthy way. I will play some games on my PC and wait for the effect. Mostly I notice the effects when I cant read very well anymore or have issues with the game controls.
T + 0:30 I feel a mild relaxation, the familiar benzo buzz. Not that strong, but very noticable.
T + 0:35 Very noticeable increase in the effects. Even feel a mild euphoric edge which not all benzos have. This could become a nice evening. :)
T + 0:50 The effects seem (from what I am used) rather mild. I was expecting more from this. Maybe its my tolerance (took lormetazepam 3 days before) or it will take a bit longer to work. Will wait a bit longer and maybe redose 0.5mg and a beer.
T 1:00 Buzz is still not that heavy and walking goes very normal. I dont have that "I have to watch out not to fall feeling that I normally have while on benzos. The euphoric effects did not increase but sort of went away. The effect seem to be more sedating. I drink another beer.
T + 1:15 Feel sedated but not like I want to sleep which I have way more with temazepam or lormetazepam. Fluni would be the even stronger sleeping benzo, but it does not seem to be the case for me. I definitely notice that I find it hard to remember what I did like 10 or 20 minutes ago
I definitely notice that I find it hard to remember what I did like 10 or 20 minutes ago
though.
T + 1:30 Time seems to pass by weirdly. I forget every time how long ago it was that I typed something here. I decide to redose 0.5mg.
T + 1:40  Definitely a big loss of grip on time and memory more than other benzo's
T + 1:50 I definitely make choices easier. Normally I would hold a bit back on rolling joint. Now I find it not a problem to smoke one.
T + 2:10 Smoked a joint with a little bit of hash. Now I definitely feel the effects. Very sedated and wobbly. Typing is hard. Gonna watch some TV.
T + 3:10 Very tired and sleepy. Feel quite fucked up. Not too bad to walk but very heavy. Going to bed now. Maybe the joint did not gave a very nice side effect.
T + 13:30 Woke up. Slept way longer than I am used to. Still feel dizzy and sedated. The kind of fucked up that I could just handle when I accidentally have to act sober but definitely not able to drive well.
T + 16:00 Still notice some memory impairment and sedation. Normally long acting benzos like diazepam or clonazepam give me a nice anxiety reduction during the day but now I just feel sedated and want to do nothing on the couch.
Conclusion:
A strong benzodiazepine with way more sedating effects than others. I was hoping to find my new favorite but it actually ends up in the bottom few of my top 10.
Thinking back about the evening I can remember quite okay what happened. 2mg clonazepam for example, makes me lose more memory so I dont know where all the scare stories come from.
